name: zero1-smartboard-simulator
description: Browser simulator for the ZERO1 Smart Board (Arduino UNO based educational board)

scripts.build: node tools/build-toolchain-bundle.mjs && node tools/fetch-toolchain.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-zero1 "npx vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zero1 "npx vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts tests-emulator/firestore.rules.test.ts"
